doc: Structure-tensor coherence: gaussian_filter(patch, 1.0) (default mode reflect, truncate 4.0; axis 0 then axis 1; the output keeps the input dtype), np.gradient (central differences inside, one-sided at the borders), products smoothed by gaussian_filter(sigma), coherence sqrt((jxx - jyy)^2 + 4 jxy^2) / (jxx + jyy) weighted by the trace. A flat patch: no gradient, trace 0, so every term is 0 / 1e-12 and the weighted sum over max(sum, 1e-12) is 0.0 (the guard branch).
